notes.content:
Hello! Just a quick little note here that if you played the demo you need to wipe your save by either deleting the files in [u]%localappdata%low\Skylor Beck\You Must Become A Lich[/u] or using the in-game wipe save button. 

Thank you for your support! Report all bugs in Discussion or Discord!
